provenance.source: GitHub Actions jobs API created_at, started_at, completed_at, and per-step durations for rue-language/rue CI runs
provenance.acquisition: For every source_run_ids entry, fetch `gh api repos/rue-language/rue/actions/runs/RUN_ID/jobs --paginate`; retain the job and step timestamps used by the evidence note.
provenance.refresh: Replace the bounded run cohort, source_run_ids, ranges, planning maxima, and indivisible-item review together; then run scripts/plan-cli-shards.py against the live Buck graph. This file is reviewed input, not an automatically complete inventory.

indivisible_inventory.scope: Fixed work observed inside each cold linux-x64 CLI lane that adding CLI runners cannot subdivide; currently the shared cold compiler build.
indivisible_inventory.acquisition: For every cold executing CLI run in source_run_ids, inspect the jobs-API step durations and retained ci-timed/what-ran evidence; record each repeated fixed-cost item and its maximum observed wall. Re-review when the workflow, Buck action graph, or compiler inputs change.

indivisible_items.name: cold compiler build
indivisible_items.source_metric: maximum cold `Build all targets` step wall in the sampled compiler-change runs

phase_6_remeasurement.comparison: Record the PR CI run IDs and observed critical paths after publication. A single run demonstrates execution of the derived topology but is not by itself causal before/after evidence; compare against an appropriately matched pre-change cohort before claiming a latency change.
